{"schema":1,"productSlug":"library-management","appId":"com.smartsaas.library","installerProfile":"win10-11-x64","version":"0.1.23","filename":"Library-Systemile-0.1.23-win10-11-x64.exe","url":"https://github.com/Dipak1533/systemile-installers/releases/download/release-2026-10-24T01-00-27-729Z/Library-Systemile-0.1.23-win10-11-x64.exe","size":384347418,"sha512":"8RlV1iYkHh6cHs7jUVh8iz7qc6v05R33Y2bwWVO1rca3axQpkUbAPPaycuDlM6/Yv2CjOLTHstfpbPDQGRRUlQ==","releaseDate":"2026-10-24T01:00:33.757Z","releaseNotes":"## Reliable saving and corrections
- Confirmed SQLite saves with safer concurrent-write rollback and reload handling.
- Salary reversals keep employee payments, expenses and cash/bank balances together.
- Receipt refunds preserve the correct discount history and reject insufficient funds.
- New monetary entries validate paisa precision.
## Accurate reports and seat availability
- Historical balances, student/booking status and exports follow the selected report date.
- Configured shift overlaps, including the last night crossing midnight, agree across reports, dashboard, seat history and assistant views.
- Closed and already renewed memberships do not reappear as active renewal reminders; deliberately reserved seats remain held.
## Record integrity and compatibility
- Duplicate new seat/locker codes, missing room links, invalid plan values and mismatched locker bookings are rejected.
- Existing data, financial history, photos/documents, licence identity and complete backup/restore are preserved.
- Includes the earlier locker-release, layout-save and India-calendar fixes."}
